The rise of discontent with the liberal democratic system is clear (Pilon 2017). But whether the discontent will be channeled toward socialist forces for systemic change is unknown, and with a consistent history of lack of revolutionary leadership on the left and the secular decline of the working class in the imperialist countries, hope for change may more likely lie in the global South.
